Generate the autocompletion script for the bash shell.

This script depends on the 'bash-completion' package.
If it is not installed already, you can install it via your OS's package manager.

To load completions in your current shell session:

	source <(headscale completion bash)

To load completions for every new session, execute once:

#### Linux:

	headscale completion bash > /etc/bash_completion.d/headscale

#### macOS:

	headscale completion bash > $(brew --prefix)/etc/bash_completion.d/headscale

You will need to start a new shell for this setup to take effect.

Use "headscale oauth-clients [command] --help" for more information about a command.

Create a general-purpose OAuth client. It authenticates with the OAuth 2.0
client-credentials grant and mints short-lived, scope-limited access tokens.
The wire format is compatible with Tailscale tooling (the Terraform provider,
the Kubernetes operator, tscli, ...), so those can drive Headscale unchanged.

The client secret is shown ONCE on creation and cannot be retrieved again; if
you lose it, delete the client and create a new one.

Scopes gate what the client's tokens may do; tags are the device tags those
tokens may assign and are required when the scopes include devices:core or
auth_keys.

Usage:
  headscale oauth-clients create [flags]

  create, c, new

  -h, --help                 help for create

  -t, --tag stringArray      Tag the client's tokens may assign to devices (repeatable), e.g. tag:k8s-operator

help.text:
headscale is an open source implementation of the Tailscale control server

https://github.com/juanfont/headscale

Usage:
  headscale [command]

Available Commands:
  apikeys       Handle the Api keys in Headscale
  auth          Manage node authentication and approval
  completion    Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  configtest    Test the configuration.
  debug         debug and testing commands
  generate      Generate commands
  health        Check the health of the Headscale server
  help          Help about any command
  mockoidc      Runs a mock OIDC server for testing
  nodes         Manage the nodes of Headscale
  oauth-clients Manage OAuth clients
  policy        Manage the Headscale ACL Policy
  preauthkeys   Handle the preauthkeys in Headscale
  serve         Launches the headscale server
  users         Manage the users of Headscale
  version       Print the version.

Flags:
  -c, --config string   config file (default is /etc/headscale/config.yaml)
      --force           Disable prompts and forces the execution
  -h, --help            help for headscale
  -o, --output string   Output format. Empty for human-readable, 'json', 'json-line' or 'yaml'

Use "headscale [command] --help" for more information about a command.

--force.help: Disable prompts and forces the execution

--output.help: Output format. Empty for human-readable, 'json', 'json-line' or 'yaml'

--tags.help: Tags to automatically assign to node

apikeys.help: Handle the Api keys in Headscale

approve-routes.help: Manage the approved routes of a node

check.help: Check the Policy file for errors

create-node.help: Create a node that can be registered with `auth register <>` command

disable.help: Set as disabled a given route

dumpConfig.help: dump current config to /etc/headscale/config.dump.yaml, integration test only

health.help: Check the health of the Headscale server

list.help: List the Api keys for headscale

mockoidc.help: Runs a mock OIDC server for testing

private-key.help: Generate a private key for the headscale server

register.help: Register a node to your network

rename.help: Renames a node in your network

tag.help: Manage the tags of a node
